image_feature_sections.title: Complexity
image_feature_sections.description: Detail load, structural subdivision, component count, contour count, holes, perimeter load, and angular point count.
image_feature_sections.family_summary: edge density, perimeter/area, quadtree variability, components, contours, holes
image_feature_sections.perception: This family approximates how visually busy or effortful a glyph is to parse. Component and contour counts are pixel-level proxies; human grouping can still differ.
image_feature_sections.low_value: Lower values usually mean a simpler, cleaner symbol with fewer parts, edges, holes, or sharp details.
image_feature_sections.high_value: Higher values usually mean a more intricate symbol that may take more attention to inspect and distinguish.

features.label: Edge density
features.meaning: How much edge/detail structure appears in the icon.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because edge load reflects visual detail and local structure.

features.label: Quadtree leaf count
features.meaning: How many spatial subdivisions are needed to describe the foreground pattern.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because more spatial subdivisions indicate more local structural variation.

features.label: Quadtree structural variability
features.meaning: How unevenly structure is distributed across the icon.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because uneven spatial structure changes perceived visual detail.

features.label: Quadtree mean leaf size
features.meaning: Average quadtree region size; smaller values imply more localized detail.
visual_category_labels: simple icon, complex icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because smaller regions indicate finer localized detail.

features.label: Connected components
features.meaning: How many separated foreground parts the icon contains.
visual_category_labels: single-object symbol, multi-component symbol
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because separated foreground parts add visual structure, while remaining a pixel-level grouping proxy.

features.label: Contour count
features.meaning: How many contour boundaries are present.
visual_category_labels: single-object symbol, multi-component symbol
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because multiple boundaries add visual detail and potential parts.

features.label: Holes count
features.meaning: How many enclosed empty spaces appear inside foreground shapes.
visual_category_labels: closed-shape icon, open-line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because enclosed empty regions add internal detail.

features.label: Perimeter-area ratio
features.meaning: How much boundary length exists relative to filled area.
visual_category_labels: filled pictogram, outline icon, line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because boundary-heavy icons often contain more contour detail relative to area.

features.label: Corner count
features.meaning: Approximate number of polygon corners across external contours.
visual_category_labels: curved icon, angular icon, sharp-cornered icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Complexity because corners and polygon vertices add angular detail.

image_feature_sections.title: Shape/silhouette
image_feature_sections.description: Silhouette, closure, roundness, rectangularity, and curvature.
image_feature_sections.family_summary: aspect ratio, solidity, closure proxy, circularity/rectangularity, curvature
image_feature_sections.perception: This family captures the overall visible form of a glyph: roundness, box-like form, elongation, closure, curvature, and global silhouette.
image_feature_sections.low_value: Lower values depend on the feature: low circularity means less round, and low closure-proxy values suggest more open or line-like form.
image_feature_sections.high_value: Higher values indicate stronger presence of that specific shape property, such as more circular, more rectangular, or more closed by proxy.

features.label: Bounding-box aspect ratio
features.meaning: Whether the active icon shape is tall, wide, or square-like.
visual_category_labels: compact icon, tall icon, wide icon, fragmented icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because it captures whether the active form is tall, wide, or square.

features.label: Solidity
features.meaning: How compactly the foreground fills its outer convex envelope.
visual_category_labels: compact icon, tall icon, wide icon, fragmented icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because compactness versus gaps changes the perceived silhouette.

features.label: Closure proxy
features.meaning: Proxy for closed-shape behavior from contours, holes, and compactness; not a direct human closure judgment.
visual_category_labels: closed-shape icon, open-line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because it approximates whether the glyph behaves like an enclosed form.

features.label: Circularity
features.meaning: How close the foreground silhouette is to a compact circle.
visual_category_labels: round icon, rectangular icon, box-like icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because roundness changes the perceived silhouette.

features.label: Rectangularity
features.meaning: How densely foreground fills its minimum enclosing rectangle.
visual_category_labels: round icon, rectangular icon, box-like icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because box-like forms are a distinct shape family.

features.label: Straight-contour share
features.meaning: Share of contour samples that behave like straight segments.
visual_category_labels: curved icon, angular icon, sharp-cornered icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because straight contour segments affect perceived geometry.

features.label: Gentle-curvature share
features.meaning: Share of contour samples with gradual curve behavior.
visual_category_labels: curved icon, angular icon, sharp-cornered icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because arcs and gentle curves affect perceived geometry.

features.label: Sharp-curvature share
features.meaning: Share of contour samples with sharp turns or angular corners.
visual_category_labels: curved icon, angular icon, sharp-cornered icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Shape/silhouette because sharp turns mark angular geometry.

image_feature_sections.title: Stroke/structure
image_feature_sections.description: Directional strokes, principal orientation, arrows, arcs, and skeleton graph structure.
image_feature_sections.family_summary: line orientation, principal axis, arrows, arcs, skeleton graph
image_feature_sections.perception: This family captures internal organization: stroke direction, branching, endpoints, arrows, and arcs. It describes visible structure, not exact text or semantic identity.
image_feature_sections.low_value: Lower values usually mean less explicit directionality, fewer skeleton branches/endpoints, or fewer arrows/arcs.
image_feature_sections.high_value: Higher values usually mean stronger directional cues, more branching structure, more endpoints/junctions, or clearer arrow components.

features.label: Horizontal line orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that is mostly horizontal.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because dominant horizontal strokes describe internal direction.

features.label: Diagonal 45 degree orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that follows a 45 degree diagonal.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because diagonal strokes describe internal direction.

features.label: Vertical line orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that is mostly vertical.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because vertical strokes describe internal direction.

features.label: Diagonal 135 degree orientation
features.meaning: Share of detected line structure that follows a 135 degree diagonal.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because diagonal strokes describe internal direction.

features.label: Principal-axis orientation
features.meaning: Dominant orientation of foreground pixels from a PCA axis; pairwise comparison should treat it as circular over 180 degrees.
visual_category_labels: horizontal icon, vertical icon, diagonal/action icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because it captures the icon's dominant visual direction.

features.label: Arrowhead count
features.meaning: Approximate count of triangular or sharp directional tips.
visual_category_labels: arrow icon, pointer icon, directional symbol
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because arrowheads are visible direction cues.

features.label: Arc count
features.meaning: Approximate count of curved arc-like contour runs.
visual_category_labels: curved icon, angular icon, sharp-cornered icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because arcs distinguish curved line construction.

features.label: Skeleton endpoints
features.meaning: Number of terminal points in the foreground skeleton graph.
visual_category_labels: simple line graph, branching line graph
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because endpoints describe line-graph structure.

features.label: Skeleton junctions
features.meaning: Number of branching points in the foreground skeleton graph.
visual_category_labels: simple line graph, branching line graph
features.category_reason: It belongs in Stroke/structure because junctions describe branching line-graph structure.

image_feature_sections.title: Density/fill
image_feature_sections.description: Foreground amount, bounding-box fill, outline-vs-fill behavior, and stroke thickness.
image_feature_sections.family_summary: foreground amount, bounding-box occupancy, filled/outline proxy, stroke width
image_feature_sections.perception: This family describes whether a glyph reads as sparse line art, a filled silhouette, or a heavy/thick mark.
image_feature_sections.low_value: Lower values usually mean a lighter, thinner, more open, or less filled glyph.
image_feature_sections.high_value: Higher values usually mean a denser, more filled, more visually heavy glyph with thicker strokes or stronger occupancy.

features.label: Foreground area ratio
features.meaning: How much of the canvas is occupied by visible foreground pixels.
visual_category_labels: sparse icon, dense icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Density/fill because it measures how much visible material occupies the canvas.

features.label: Bounding-box occupancy
features.meaning: How densely the icon fills its active bounding box.
visual_category_labels: sparse icon, dense icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Density/fill because it measures how tightly the visible form fills its active area.

features.label: Filled-vs-outline proxy
features.meaning: Whether the icon behaves more like a filled mark or an outline/line drawing.
visual_category_labels: filled pictogram, outline icon, line icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Density/fill because it separates filled marks from outline-like rendering.

features.label: Mean stroke width
features.meaning: Average normalized stroke width estimated from the foreground skeleton.
visual_category_labels: thin-line icon, thick-stroke icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Density/fill because line thickness changes visual weight.

features.label: Stroke-width variation
features.meaning: Variation in normalized stroke width across the skeleton.
visual_category_labels: thin-line icon, thick-stroke icon
features.category_reason: It belongs in Density/fill because stroke-width variation changes visual weight and fill behavior.

image_feature_sections.title: Balance/layout

image_feature_sections.family_summary: symmetry, centroid, bounding-box position/size, 4x4 grid occupancy
image_feature_sections.perception: This family captures where visual mass sits and whether the glyph feels centered, balanced, symmetric, top-heavy, side-heavy, compact, or spread out. Grid features should be treated as one layout channel when comparing families.
image_feature_sections.low_value: Lower values often mean less offset or less occupancy in a given region; for symmetry scores, lower means less balanced.
image_feature_sections.high_value: Higher values often mean stronger occupancy in a region, larger active extent, more offset for distance features, or stronger balance for symmetry scores.
